children: VANCOUVER – TheNewswire - September 15, 2026 - Providence Gold Mines Inc. (TSXV: PHD OTC PINKS: PRRVF) (“Providence” or the “Company”) announces a non-brokered private placement of up to 20,000,000 units at a price of $0.05 per unit for gross proceeds of up to $1,000,000 (the “Offering”). Each unit consists of one common share and one share purchase warrant exercisable at a price of $0.07 for a period of one year. Proceeds raised from the Offering will be used to further advance the La Dama De Oro Gold Property and for general and administrative purposes.
Finders’ fees may be paid pursuant to this financing.
The financing is subject to TSX Venture Approval.
